text: Sunday is a day of rest in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Almost all shops are closed, and loud work such as mowing the lawn or drilling is not welcome. Restaurants, cafés, museums, cinemas and theatres stay open, so many people go for a walk, visit family or go out for a meal.
This is why a Sunday invitation in German is usually for a walk, lunch or a trip, rather than a shopping trip. Plan your shopping for Saturday.
